name: Icon Button
description: A square button that holds only an icon, in the same six weights and three sizes as Button, with a pending state.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Required. The accessible name, since the button has no visible text.

props.name: children
props.description: The icon. Sized to 16 pixels, or 18 at the large size.

props.name: variant
props.description: Visual weight, the same values as Button.

props.name: isPending
props.description: Swaps the icon for a spinner, sets aria-busy and blocks presses.

props.name: onPress
props.description: Called when the button is pressed by mouse, touch or keyboard.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged with cn(). Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Button except children.
